QuestInfo.name: To Ereve, the Sky Island
QuestInfo.0: You've decided to head to Ereve to become the Knight of Light. Talk to Neinheart when you're ready to go.
QuestInfo.1:
You've decided to head to Ereve to become the Knight of Light. Talk to Neinheart when you're ready to go.

#b(If there is a problem during the quest, you can forfeit it and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2: Ereve, the Sky Island, throne of the Empress and home of the Piyo Tribe. Shinsoo, Ereve's protector since time immemorial, apparently channels her power through the Emperor and Empress. Here, you can train with the newly formed Cygnus Knights to unlock your full potential.
